World Leading Manufacturer of Fountains and Display Aerators

Aqua Control® has a mission:
to provide the world with the greatest fountains and display aerators, along with amazing customer
service and technical support.

Aqua Control® is continually doing research and development in the industry, leading the way for a
continual flow of incredible water features. Aqua Control® has a stunning range of products from
Do-It-Yourself plug and perform fountains, to towering Titans blasting geysers 100 feet tall.

We also have everything in between, from waterfalls, healthy pond and lake aeration products, to
brilliant lighting systems to enjoy your water feature at night, as well as the day. Since 1970,
Aqua Control® has built a healthy appreciation of Earth’s most precious resource, water.

Aqua Control® focuses on creating and maintaining the best patterns in the industry. Aqua Control’s®
patterns yield consistent solid thick streams that stay strong in a breeze and maintain a consistent
flow for a great distance.

Aqua Control® provides pumps that not only produce high volumes, with high pressures, but also
breathtaking patterns, while concentrating on motor longevity, providing a long lasting and
affordable pump.

municipal tank mixing systems that revitalize water and endure the test of time.

Our innovative water quality products are the most efficient and effective solutions for keeping
water in motion. We promote thriving ponds and lakes, pristine marinas and waterfronts, and safe,
healthy communities for years to come.

provide an unwavering commitment to our customers.

World Leading Manufacturer of Fountains and Display Aerators

Aqua Control® has a mission:
to provide the world with the greatest fountains and display aerators, along with amazing customer
service and technical support.

Aqua Control® is continually doing research and development in the industry, leading the way for a
continual flow of incredible water features. Aqua Control® has a stunning range of products from
Do-It-Yourself plug and perform fountains, to towering Titans blasting geysers 100 feet tall.

We also have everything in between, from waterfalls, healthy pond and lake aeration products, to
brilliant lighting systems to enjoy your water feature at night, as well as the day. Since 1970,
Aqua Control® has built a healthy appreciation of Earth’s most precious resource, water.

Aqua Control® focuses on creating and maintaining the best patterns in the industry. Aqua Control’s®
patterns yield consistent solid thick streams that stay strong in a breeze and maintain a consistent
flow for a great distance.

Aqua Control® provides pumps that not only produce high volumes, with high pressures, but also
breathtaking patterns, while concentrating on motor longevity, providing a long lasting and
affordable pump.

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

## Custom PIT Tag Monitoring Solutions

[Biomark]

Biomark specializes in the design, construction, and installation of custom PIT tag systems for
terrestrial and aquatic use. Our experience allows us to design and test numerous antenna sizes and
configurations to meet the needs of unique monitoring applications. Whether your site is in a
metropolis or on a remote mountaintop, we can provide a monitoring solution. We have been building
customized PIT tag detection systems for nearly 30 years. No project is too big or small and our
carefully selected components collectively result in a robust and reliable system. Take a look at a
few of our [terrestrial][81], [aquatic][82] and [custom system solutions][83] or contact our
team [biomarkservice@merck.com][84] to discuss your project needs.

**Changyu Pump** is a trusted **chemical pump manufacturer** established in 2006, specializing
in corrosion-resistant pump solutions for aggressive and complex fluids. Our main products
include magnetic drive pumps, centrifugal pumps, self-priming pumps, slurry pumps, and submersible
pumps, widely used in chemical processing, electroplating, wastewater treatment, mining, and
environmental applications.

Backed by strong manufacturing capability and industry experience, we help global customers improve
fluid transfer safety, reduce leakage risk, and achieve long-term operating reliability with
professional **industrial pump systems** and customized service.

###### FAQS

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are you a manufacturer or trading company?

A: We are a professional manufacturer in chemical pumps with high quality for more than 20 years.

Q: How to customize pumps and mechanical seals ?

A: Customers could send us application data, we will select suitable pump and seal types, or client
could send us drawings, We are well in OEM and ODM.

Q: How can I pay for my items? Which kind of payment can you provide?

A: Usually by T/T, 30% payment after PI confirmed, the 70% balance should be paid after inspection
before shipment. and L/C at sight.

Q: What information should I offer for quotation?

Medium: ******________******
PH: ________
Specific gravity: ________
Medium temperature: ________
Flow: ________m3/h
Head: _________m
Voltage: ____________V
Frequency: _________Hz
Power:_____________KW

Q: What is your minimum quantity?

A: One set is also welcomed to us.

Q: How long is warranty?

A: 1 year for main construction warranty.

Q: What is your lead time?

A: Normally 10 days. If client is in urgent, we have plenty of spare parts, we could finish
assembling and testing in 3-5 days.

Q: What about shipment or delivery?

A: Depends on customer’s requirements, We can do EXW, FOB, CIF,etc.

CNP integrates the advanced R&D technologies from Europe and America, with the most advanced
industrial design concept in Western Europe, with the production experience of modern industrial
clusters in North America, with the most efficient and energy-saving product structure research in
Hangzhou, China.

With the application of information technology, CNP has built its own smart factory, taking the lead
in the introduction of SAP resource management system, becoming one of the key units of the key
construction project of  "machine substitution" in Hangzhou, with the whole process of production
information monitoring and tracking, applying laser welding technology to the manufacturing process
of robot pump spare parts in depth, using progressive die technology to ensure the quality of the
whole process of the parts, all of which greatly reduce the production and manufacturing cycle,
provide an intelligent production and manufacturing basis for the pump production.

CNP was recognized as state-certified enterprise technology center in 2016. It is the highest
evaluation level for technology center in China. Besides, CNP has been carrying some technical
courses in 11/12/13th National Five-Year Plan.

CNP uses digital integrated intelligent control technology to create domestic advanced M2M mode,
intelligent control technology.

It includes intelligent current stabilization system, intelligent vacuum suppression system,
intelligent auxiliary control monitoring system, intelligent non-negative pressure full frequency
control system and intelligent water hammer two-way elimination system.

**About Us**

We, C.P.V. Engineer Pvt. Ltd., capitalizing on our assets - a world class manufacturing plant,
well-knit network of offices, credible local representatives/agents/dealers based across major
locations of the world, have emerged as a champion in our domain since establishment in 1989. We are
an industry-leading manufacturer and  exporter having proven expertise in offering different types
of Centrifugal Chemical Process Pumps, Chemical Pumps, Chemical Horizontal Self Priming Process
Pumps,  High Pressure Centrifugal Pumps etc. We also deal in Chemical Vertical Sump Pumps, Chemical
Horizontal Process Pumps, and more.

Our rich industry experience spanning over three decades lends us deep functional expertise and
excellent market know-how. This perfectly acquaints us with various application & customers' needs
based on which we design our products. We have resources in place to provide custom-designed pumping
solutions to clients aligning with any type of pumping requirements. Today, our range finds suitable
application in Chemical, Pharmaceutical, Starch, Edible Oil, Textile, Fertilizer, Paper and Effluent
Treatment Industries.

Our entire range is engineered using high grade cast iron, cast steel, and stainless steel, which
gives it durable finish, unmatched functionality, excellent strength, and so forth. All our products
conform to international standards and norms, and enjoy wide demand in India and major international
markets.

**Product Range**

Our product range encompasses the following: (MOC: CI, CS, SS-304/316, CD4MCU, ALLOY-20, HASTALLOY-
B & C, etc.)

* Series 5000 ANSI Chemical Centrifugal Pumps (Back pull-out type)
* Centrifugal Chemical Pumps (Non Back pullout type)
* High Temperature & High Pressure Pumps
* Expeller Design Pumps
* Vertical Sump Pumps
* Self Priming Pumps
* High Pressure Centrifugal Pumps

# Welcome to Framo

Safe, efficient and reliable pumping systems.

For over half a century, our world-leading pump technology has revolutionized marine cargo pumping.
Framo has supplied cargo pumping systems to the majority of chemical and product tankers worldwide,
and are recognized as a standard in the marine industry. We are also driving greater short-term and
long-term profitability in hundreds of oil and gas installations worldwide.
 
Our strong customer focus, unique pumping concepts, high-quality engineering and dedicated service
ensures overall performance in challenging pumping operations.

# The Framo Advantage

We see our products through from design to full scale testing at our own production facilities
outside Bergen, Norway. Full worldwide support throughout the service life of the products - no
matter the problem.

Our strong customer focus has resulted in pumping systems developed in close collaboration with our
customers, with the aim to enhance safe, efficient and reliable pumping operations.

göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

Lading) verilerine ulaşın. Rakiplerinizi analiz edin, yeni pazarlar keşfedin ve ticaret hacminizi
genişletin.

## Küresel Ticari İstihbarat ve Analiz Hizmetleri

TurkExim'in dış ticarette neden en güvenilir iş ortağınız olduğunu keşfedin.

### Biz Kimiz?

TurkExim, dünya çapındaki 39'dan fazla ülkede ithalatçı ve ihracatçı firmaların doğrudan ve şeffaf
bağlar kurmasına olanak tanıyan küresel bir ticari istihbarat platformudur. Milyonlarca ham gümrük
beyannamesini işlenebilir ticari verilere dönüştürerek satış ekiplerinizin nokta atışı ihracat
hedeflerine ulaşmasını sağlıyoruz.

[ Çözümlerimizi Keşfedin → ][27]

### Konşimento Veritabanı (Bill of Lading)

TurkExim Konşimento Veritabanı, gümrüklerde kullanılan Armonize Sistem (GTİP / HS Code) kodlarına
göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde
yükleme yaptığını tam şeffaflıkla inceleyebilir ve tedarik zincirindeki hareketleri gerçek zamanlı
görebilirsiniz.

[ Konşimento Verilerini İnceleyin → ][28]

## Canlı Veri Arama Deneyimi

GTİP veya Ürün Adı girerek küresel veri tabanımızın nasıl çalıştığını simüle edin.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

About Us

## About  Us

##### Our Business Approach

 

##### Product Design Philosophy

 

##### Infrastructure & Facilities

##### Social Development

An institution owes its existence to the people and the society at large. We strongly believe that
social development through various outreach and awareness programs is as important as development of
the company. Instead of a responsibility, we perceive social development as the primary purpose of
the existence of the company. Through various art forms like music and theatre we support awareness
programs  related to water usage and recycling.

We have built state of the art infrastructure which is also being evolved continuously to leverage
technological improvements in the design and manufacturing processes. Our complete in-house control
on the design and manufacture of the components ensures highest level of quality required after
thoroughly understanding the application requirements. The manufacturing facilities are spread out
across 4 locations which each plant specialising in a particular process. 

We design & manufacture tailor-made products for pumping and mixing of corrosive, abrasive and
solids laden liquids, alongwith suitable service support for critical applications including sewage,
seawater, industrial wastewater, chemical processes, & corrosive liquids. We have one of widest
spectrums of material options to suit the application based on over 5 decades of experience and
expertise. At the core of product selection process, lies a deep understanding of the application
and the environment in which the pump is supposed to operate,  ensuring optimal selection to suit
the requirement.

The design procedure for the products revolves around a holistic approach which incorporates factors
that optimise the resource efficiency over the lifecycle of the product. Every product designed from
concept to its final form, minimises the impact on natural resources. We have to realise that the
environment has limited capacity to supply us with the valuable natural resources which the Earth is
endowed with. The design philosophy revolves around maximising of reuse and recycling of the
materials used in manufacturing.

# ONE-STOP SHOP RAS EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER

Recirculating aquaculture systems from equipment design and manufacturing to equipment supply and
installation support at your fish farm development or any land based aquaculture application.

[Recirculating aquaculture systems - ras]

## BEST SELLING AQUACULTURE FILTRATION EQUIPMENT

[[Compact recirculating aquaculture system cras 100]][48] [

### RAS Skid Filtration Units

][49]

Fully integrated plug & play and factory tested RAS filtration technology. It covers mechanical,
biological, chemical and disinfection filtration processes and state of the art monitoring with low
energy consumption and ease of operation. RAS Skids are tailor made solutions to fit your needs,
site conditions and available space.

[[Freshwater protein skimmer aquaculture]][50] [

### Freshwater Protein Skimmers

][51]

Seafood farmers, especially Salmon Farmers, requested MAT-KULING to develop an efficient Freshwater
Protein Skimmer able to perform in fresh and brackish water conditions and installed for land based
salmon tanks. The protein skimmer is an add-on to the existing filtration setup.

[[Foam fractionator aquaculture]][52] [

### Saltwater Protein Skimmers

][53]

The Protein Skimmers made of PE & PP bodies come ready with Venturi pumps, automated protein foam
level control, skimmer cap sludge autowash, control panel & ozone/oxygen intake. Assembled and
hydrotested ready for installation.

[[Drum filters for aquaculture]][54] [

### Drum Filters

][55]

Drum Filters suitable for aquaculture fish farms, salmon farms, saltwater applications or
hippopotamus zoos and elephant zoological water.

[[Ozone generators suitable for aquaculture farms & fish hatcheries]][56] [

### Ozone Generators

## About Oswal Pumps

Oswal Pumps Limited, commenced its operations in 2003, is now recognized as one of the fastest
growing company, vertically integrated solar pump manufacturers in india. Its success can be
attributed to a highly experienced team of engineers and technicians, who have contributed to the
Company's growth in the field of solar pumps, submersible pumps, monoblock pumps, pressure pumps,
sewage pumps, electric motors, spanning across domestic, agricultural, and industrial ranges. The
company's manufacturing facility spans across an area of 41076 sq. meters which is strategically
located in or near major agricultural states such as Haryana, Punjab and Uttar Pradesh and is
equipped with modern machineries. Oswal Pumps Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company and its
products are marked with ISI and BEE certifications.

### 
### ShenGu Group , a Global Actor 
### in Process and Energy Equipment

###### About ShenGu Group

         Established in 1952, the ShenGu Group Co., Ltd (ShenGu Group) dedicates itself to the
research, development, design, and manufacturing of turbomachinery including
centrifugal/axial/reciprocating compressors, centrifugal blowers and pumps. The main areas of its
application are oil & gas, chemical, metallurgy, power generation, etc.


        Through continuous investments in facilities and product development, ShenGu Group has
achieved a dominant position in both Chinese and overseas market.  

        Nowadays, ShenGu Group has 80% of China’s local market share and has installations in over
40 countries.

 

Basic data:


Area total: 1.6 million m2

Employee:   More than 6,500.

Production equipment:

More than 2000 Machining equipment.

Testing capacity:

More than  30 test beds with capacity up to 100,000KW

 

[MAC180 Rotor assembly in shop.jpg]

## ShenGu Group, a top manufacturer delivers 300+ large gas compressors per year.

ShenGu Group has developed a wide range of new products, including  25MW high speed natural gas
pipeline booster compressor,  1.5 million tons/year ethylene plants centrifugal compressors,  2.5
million tons/year methanol plants compressors and key compression equipment for refineries up to 40
million tons/year capacity, as well as air separation plants capacity up to 150,000 Nm3/h of oxygen.
 

## QUALITY CERTIFICATES

ISO 9001: 2008

ISO 14000: 2004

ISO 12012: 2003

Core Products
* TP Vertical Inline pump
  TP Series Vertical Inline pump is a single- stage and single- suction vertical centrifugal pump.
  This series is designed for maximum 140℃ water and industrial fluids.The material of pump casing
  is cast iron HT250 and ductile iron QT400. The pumps are equipped with air-cooled asynchronous
  motors. Using standard IE3 motor, users can easily equip the motor according to their needs. The
  pumps are equipped with a mechanical shaft seal.Radial and axial forces are absorbed by the motor
  bearings, so additional bearings in the pump section are not required. The flow parts of the pump
  and the impeller are covered with a corrosion-resistant cataphoresis coating. According to the
  pump performance and design pressure and temperature, TP pump is divided into two
  sub-series:PN16/PN25
  [Read More][26]

* TWZ Horizontal Close Coupled End Suction Pump
  TWZ pumps are non-self-priming, single-stage, cantilever monoblock centrifugal volute pumps with
  axial inlet port, radial outlet port and horizontal shaft on the base. They are available in PN16
  and PN25 body pressure versions. The pumps are fitted with air-cooled asynchronous motors.
  Impeller and motor shaft are connected via a rigid sleeve coupling (stub shaft). The pumps are
  fitted with a mechanical shaft seal. The pumps provide a compact arrangement ideal for
  installations where space is at a premium. With its compact and space-saving design, this pump is
  ideal for use in industrial, commercial, and residential settings where space is limited.In fact,
  TWZ series horizontal rigid coupled cantilever single-stage single-suction centrifugal pump is
  derived from TPW series. It shares the same pump body,impeller as TPW and the same motor support
  as TP series. TWZ features a higher operating temperature than TPW.

  TWX pumps are non-self-priming, single-stage, cantilever centrifugal volute pumps with axial inlet
  port, radial outlet port and horizontal shaft on the base frame. The overall structure of the pump
  is advanced and reasonable, and motor and pump direct connection design, reducing the floor area.
  The pumps are fitted with a mechanical shaft seal. And can be configured seals for different fluid
  media. The pumps are of the back-pull-out design, that is you can remove the motor, motor stool
  and impeller without disturbing the pump housing or pipes. At the same time, it can be applied to
  different pipeline system caliber and pressure level configuration.
  [Read More][30]
  [ [TWX Horizontal Long Coupled End Suction Pump] ][31]

  WQ submersible sewage pump uses a special submersible electric motor at the top and a pump at the
  bottom. The medium to be pumped is sucked in axially from the bottom, then discharged laterally
  from the pump body.
  
  The impeller is fixed on the motor shaft extension, forming a common rotor component with the
  motor shaft. The pump body and pump cover together form the pressure boundary, designed for a
  temperature of 40°C. The design pressure for pumps with a head of less than 40m is 0.6MPa, and for
  pumps with a head of ≥40m, the design pressure is 1.0MPa. O-rings are used as reliable static
  seals at the connections between parts.

* TWX Horizontal Long Coupled End Suction Pump
  TWX pumps are non-self-priming, single-stage, cantilever centrifugal volute pumps with axial inlet
  port, radial outlet port and horizontal shaft on the base frame. The overall structure of the pump
  is advanced and reasonable, and motor and pump direct connection design, reducing the floor area.
  The pumps are fitted with a mechanical shaft seal. And can be configured seals for different fluid
  media. The pumps are of the back-pull-out design, that is you can remove the motor, motor stool
  and impeller without disturbing the pump housing or pipes. At the same time, it can be applied to
  different pipeline system caliber and pressure level configuration.
  [Read More][30]
  [ [TWX Horizontal Long Coupled End Suction Pump] ][31]
* WQ Big Submersible Sewage Pump
  WQ submersible sewage pump uses a special submersible electric motor at the top and a pump at the
  bottom. The medium to be pumped is sucked in axially from the bottom, then discharged laterally
  from the pump body.
  
  The impeller is fixed on the motor shaft extension, forming a common rotor component with the
  motor shaft. The pump body and pump cover together form the pressure boundary, designed for a
  temperature of 40°C. The design pressure for pumps with a head of less than 40m is 0.6MPa, and for
  pumps with a head of ≥40m, the design pressure is 1.0MPa. O-rings are used as reliable static
  seals at the connections between parts.

  and liquids with properties similar to water in terms of viscosity and chemical activity, with
  temperatures up to 80°C, (on request up to 180°C).Our impeller could be customized with different
  material ranging from cast iron to stainless steel to meet customers' needs.

* XBD-TQW Single Stage Horizontal Fire Pump
  (1) The XBD-W series features a horizontal single-stage end suction design with a cantilever
  close-coupled structure suitable for fixed firefighting applications. The pump impeller is
  directly mounted on the extended shaft of the motor. Both the pump inlet and outlet are flanged
  connections, with axial inlet port, radial outlet port and horizontal shaft on the base. The pump
  does not have bearings; both axial and radial forces are supported by the motor's bearings. The
  pump and motor are connected via bolts on a common base.

fish **[counters][43]**, fish **[graders][44]**, and fish **[pumps][45]** for the global aquaculture

using the best available technology solutions for the demands of our customers.

[Learn more][50]

**[GRADERS][51]**

**HIGH-PRECISION GRADING **

VAKI offers a versatile range of Fish Graders (both Smart Roller Graders and Drum Graders) to
deliver grading while minimizing the impact on the fish.

[Learn more][52]

**[PUMPS][53]**

**HIGH CAPACITY, EFFICIENT & EASY TO MOVE**

Available in three sizes and either the Basic or Smart Pump model, VAKI fish pumps offer a gentle
and fast way to transfer fish – reducing operating costs and improving efficiency.

[Learn more][54]

**[SMARTFLOW][55]**

**SETTING NEW STANDARDS FOR THE INDUSTRY **

VAKI SmartFlow is an automated and customised solution that delivers* *real-time monitoring
technology to advance fish health with welfare-friendly fish handling, counting and grading.

[Learn more][56]

**VAKI SMARTFLOW** — THE ULTIMATE FISH HANDLING SOLUTION

Built with farmers in mind, and with fish welfare at its core, our industry leading **VAKI
SmartFlow** System connects all VAKI Smart Pumps^{*}, Graders and Counters for full overview and
control of the fish handling system.

This revolutionizes production efficiency by leveraging real-time monitoring, remote control,
automation, and reporting to deliver key insights for decision making and informed planning.

**Explore our solutions for hatcheries, wellboats and sea pens — [click to download our interactive
PDF to learn more.][57]**

** Non-Smart Pumps may be used in the SmartFlow system, but pumping automation, remote-control and
monitoring capabilities will be lost.*

What if you only had to rely on one proven partner for all your maritime safety needs?

**VIKING Life-Saving Equipment** brings you all the solutions you need to stay safe and
compliant. Our range includes everything from lifeboats, fast rescue boats and evacuation systems to
liferafts, personal protective gear, firefighting equipment and safety training.

Powered by the industry’s strongest network, we provide worldwide multi-brand equipment service with
OEM quality and support the thousands of maritime and offshore operators who prefer subscribing to
safety compliance with a fixed price safety agreement.

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

[Read more][67]

CNP integrates the advanced R&D technologies from Europe and America, with the most advanced
industrial design concept in Western Europe, with the production experience of modern industrial
clusters in North America, with the most efficient and energy-saving product structure research in
Hangzhou, China.

With the application of information technology, CNP has built its own smart factory, taking the lead
in the introduction of SAP resource management system, becoming one of the key units of the key
construction project of  "machine substitution" in Hangzhou, with the whole process of production
information monitoring and tracking, applying laser welding technology to the manufacturing process
of robot pump spare parts in depth, using progressive die technology to ensure the quality of the
whole process of the parts, all of which greatly reduce the production and manufacturing cycle,
provide an intelligent production and manufacturing basis for the pump production.

CNP was recognized as state-certified enterprise technology center in 2016. It is the highest
evaluation level for technology center in China. Besides, CNP has been carrying some technical
courses in 11/12/13th National Five-Year Plan.

CNP uses digital integrated intelligent control technology to create domestic advanced M2M mode,
intelligent control technology.

It includes intelligent current stabilization system, intelligent vacuum suppression system,
intelligent auxiliary control monitoring system, intelligent non-negative pressure full frequency
control system and intelligent water hammer two-way elimination system.

**About Us**

We, C.P.V. Engineer Pvt. Ltd., capitalizing on our assets - a world class manufacturing plant,
well-knit network of offices, credible local representatives/agents/dealers based across major
locations of the world, have emerged as a champion in our domain since establishment in 1989. We are
an industry-leading manufacturer and  exporter having proven expertise in offering different types
of Centrifugal Chemical Process Pumps, Chemical Pumps, Chemical Horizontal Self Priming Process
Pumps,  High Pressure Centrifugal Pumps etc. We also deal in Chemical Vertical Sump Pumps, Chemical
Horizontal Process Pumps, and more.

excellent market know-how. This perfectly acquaints us with various application & customers' needs
based on which we design our products. We have resources in place to provide custom-designed pumping

application in Chemical, Pharmaceutical, Starch, Edible Oil, Textile, Fertilizer, Paper and Effluent
Treatment Industries.

gives it durable finish, unmatched functionality, excellent strength, and so forth. All our products
conform to international standards and norms, and enjoy wide demand in India and major international
markets.

[How a Slovenian SME is pushing green construction into the digital era][39]

A Slovenian green-building company, Cogreen Integrated Hemp Building Solutions, is upgrading its
hempcrete innovation with advanced digital tools. With support from a leading Slovenian university,
CoGreen is adopting BIM, AI analytics, and XR technologies to scale prefabricated, modular, and
sustainable construction.
* 23 Jul 2026

[Aerial view of Earth’s oceans with a colour-coded scale for the location of fish]
[Finding fish is no longer a guessing game with AI-driven location forecasting][40]

Using historical data, satellite images and supercomputing, the Iceland-based company GreenFish
provides 10-day forecasts to fishing industry captains and fleet managers. Faced with financial and
technological hurdles due to its rapid growth, the company sought help from the Enterprise Europe
Network.
* 16 Jul 2026

[A Nira water pump with a blue top and silver metal handle ]
[Finnish hand pumps become more sustainable][41]

When Finnish company Nira Pumps needed to cut energy costs, it turned to Europe for help. By
investing in sustainability, this pump manufacturer transformed its business with the future in
mind.

with combinations of luxury kitchen appliances designed to work seamlessly together.

# Welcome to Framo

Safe, efficient and reliable pumping systems.

For over half a century, our world-leading pump technology has revolutionized marine cargo pumping.
Framo has supplied cargo pumping systems to the majority of chemical and product tankers worldwide,
and are recognized as a standard in the marine industry. We are also driving greater short-term and
long-term profitability in hundreds of oil and gas installations worldwide.
 
Our strong customer focus, unique pumping concepts, high-quality engineering and dedicated service
ensures overall performance in challenging pumping operations.

# The Framo Advantage

We see our products through from design to full scale testing at our own production facilities
outside Bergen, Norway. Full worldwide support throughout the service life of the products - no
matter the problem.

Our strong customer focus has resulted in pumping systems developed in close collaboration with our
customers, with the aim to enhance safe, efficient and reliable pumping operations.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

About Us

## About  Us

##### Our Business Approach

 

##### Product Design Philosophy

 

##### Infrastructure & Facilities

##### Social Development

An institution owes its existence to the people and the society at large. We strongly believe that
social development through various outreach and awareness programs is as important as development of
the company. Instead of a responsibility, we perceive social development as the primary purpose of
the existence of the company. Through various art forms like music and theatre we support awareness
programs  related to water usage and recycling.

We have built state of the art infrastructure which is also being evolved continuously to leverage
technological improvements in the design and manufacturing processes. Our complete in-house control
on the design and manufacture of the components ensures highest level of quality required after
thoroughly understanding the application requirements. The manufacturing facilities are spread out
across 4 locations which each plant specialising in a particular process. 

We design & manufacture tailor-made products for pumping and mixing of corrosive, abrasive and
solids laden liquids, alongwith suitable service support for critical applications including sewage,
seawater, industrial wastewater, chemical processes, & corrosive liquids. We have one of widest
spectrums of material options to suit the application based on over 5 decades of experience and
expertise. At the core of product selection process, lies a deep understanding of the application
and the environment in which the pump is supposed to operate,  ensuring optimal selection to suit
the requirement.

The design procedure for the products revolves around a holistic approach which incorporates factors
that optimise the resource efficiency over the lifecycle of the product. Every product designed from
concept to its final form, minimises the impact on natural resources. We have to realise that the
environment has limited capacity to supply us with the valuable natural resources which the Earth is
endowed with. The design philosophy revolves around maximising of reuse and recycling of the
materials used in manufacturing.

# ONE-STOP SHOP RAS EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURER

Recirculating aquaculture systems from equipment design and manufacturing to equipment supply and
installation support at your fish farm development or any land based aquaculture application.

[Recirculating aquaculture systems - ras]

## BEST SELLING AQUACULTURE FILTRATION EQUIPMENT

[[Compact recirculating aquaculture system cras 100]][48] [

### RAS Skid Filtration Units

][49]

Fully integrated plug & play and factory tested RAS filtration technology. It covers mechanical,
biological, chemical and disinfection filtration processes and state of the art monitoring with low
energy consumption and ease of operation. RAS Skids are tailor made solutions to fit your needs,
site conditions and available space.

[[Freshwater protein skimmer aquaculture]][50] [

### Freshwater Protein Skimmers

][51]

Seafood farmers, especially Salmon Farmers, requested MAT-KULING to develop an efficient Freshwater
Protein Skimmer able to perform in fresh and brackish water conditions and installed for land based
salmon tanks. The protein skimmer is an add-on to the existing filtration setup.

[[Foam fractionator aquaculture]][52] [

### Saltwater Protein Skimmers

][53]

The Protein Skimmers made of PE & PP bodies come ready with Venturi pumps, automated protein foam
level control, skimmer cap sludge autowash, control panel & ozone/oxygen intake. Assembled and
hydrotested ready for installation.

[[Drum filters for aquaculture]][54] [

### Drum Filters

][55]

Drum Filters suitable for aquaculture fish farms, salmon farms, saltwater applications or
hippopotamus zoos and elephant zoological water.

[[Ozone generators suitable for aquaculture farms & fish hatcheries]][56] [

### Ozone Generators

][57]

Ozone Generators designed and tested for RAS applications. Fabricated in respect with EU & US HSE
guidelines in our factory with quality components easy to repair or replace. Equipped with control
panel and optionally with oxygen concentrators, air chillers and air dryers.

[[Mbbr aquaculture moving bed biofilm reactor filter]][58] [

### Moving Bed Biofilter Reactors (MBBR)

][59]

The MBBR filters are made of PP plastic and they are designed to create proper media swell, allowing
maximum bacteria oxygenation with minimal backwash requirements. Filled with floating biomedia will
provide optimum biological filtration support.

70% particles removal.

FILTRATION TECHNOLOGIES and KULING VANNBEHANDLING and is specialized in Recirculating Aquaculture

providing turn key fish operator solutions.** Our technology covers from equipment design and
manufacturing, and supply to training and installation support at your fish farm development or any
land based aquaculture application. Our RAS equipment range covers the latest technology in
mechanical and biological filtration as well as disinfection systems such as ozone and UV solutions.
On the contrary, it aims to be subcontracted for the complete filtration scope supply and
installation support for all MEP and RAS equipment of a fish farm or hatchery. We sell equipment and

operators.

### 
### ShenGu Group , a Global Actor 
### in Process and Energy Equipment

###### About ShenGu Group

         Established in 1952, the ShenGu Group Co., Ltd (ShenGu Group) dedicates itself to the
research, development, design, and manufacturing of turbomachinery including
centrifugal/axial/reciprocating compressors, centrifugal blowers and pumps. The main areas of its
application are oil & gas, chemical, metallurgy, power generation, etc.


        Through continuous investments in facilities and product development, ShenGu Group has
achieved a dominant position in both Chinese and overseas market.  

        Nowadays, ShenGu Group has 80% of China’s local market share and has installations in over
40 countries.

 

Basic data:


Area total: 1.6 million m2

Employee:   More than 6,500.

Production equipment:

More than 2000 Machining equipment.

Testing capacity:

More than  30 test beds with capacity up to 100,000KW

 

[MAC180 Rotor assembly in shop.jpg]

## ShenGu Group, a top manufacturer delivers 300+ large gas compressors per year.

ShenGu Group has developed a wide range of new products, including  25MW high speed natural gas
pipeline booster compressor,  1.5 million tons/year ethylene plants centrifugal compressors,  2.5
million tons/year methanol plants compressors and key compression equipment for refineries up to 40
million tons/year capacity, as well as air separation plants capacity up to 150,000 Nm3/h of oxygen.
 

## QUALITY CERTIFICATES

ISO 9001: 2008

ISO 14000: 2004

ISO 12012: 2003

[Learn more][54]

**SETTING NEW STANDARDS FOR THE INDUSTRY **

[Learn more][56]

SmartFlow** System connects all VAKI Smart Pumps^{*}, Graders and Counters for full overview and
control of the fish handling system.

This revolutionizes production efficiency by leveraging real-time monitoring, remote control,
automation, and reporting to deliver key insights for decision making and informed planning.

**Explore our solutions for hatcheries, wellboats and sea pens — [click to download our interactive
PDF to learn more.][57]**

monitoring capabilities will be lost.*

technological R&D of aquarium equipment, large-scale production, and the construction of a global
